Thanks Evan & Priya — great meeting this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side:

- Goal: 8-week pilot to validate latency/cost improvements for FinPay's real-time reconciliation workflows.
- Success criteria: 95th p50 latency < 250ms for typical 512-token requests; 20% reduction in per-token cost vs current setup; no PII persisted outside customer-controlled storage.

Actions we agreed on:
1) Share a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and stakeholder map for you to fill out — I attached a template (FinPay-MAP-template.xlsx).
2) FinPay to confirm economic buyer + procurement/legal contacts and an expected procurement timeline.
3) Redwood to provide SOC2 excerpt and short security Q&A; Dev will follow up on integration checklist and SSO options.

Planned owners:
- Marissa (AE) — MAP & timelines
- Camila (Sales Eng) — security/tech checklist and PoC plan
- Dev (SRE) — integration / SSO / data retention answers

Can you confirm the names and whether procurement is planning a formal RFP or a straight SOW/PO process? If you can fill the MAP and return by EOD Friday (6/18), we’ll lock dates for a kickoff the week of 6/21.

Thanks — looking forward.

—

Hi Evan — quick tech/security notes to include in the MAP and share with Mark: 

- Audit logging: Redwood provides request-level audit logs with configurable retention windows; default 90 days, options for 1/3/7 year retention via customer-managed S3 integration.
- Encryption: data in transit TLS1.2+; at-rest encryption with customer-managed KMS supported for Private deployments.
- Access controls: RBAC at token and route level; integrates with Okta for SSO via SAML + SCIM provisioning.
- SOC2: attaching an excerpt that summarizes controls; we can provide the full report under an NDA.

Doc/links to share: SOC2-excerpt.pdf (attached), security checklist (short Drive doc) — I'll drop the Drive link in the MAP.

For procurement: typical documents we need back from FinPay are a standard PO or SOW and procurement contact + billing address. If you want, we can prepare a simple SOW template this week and start DocuSign once legal signs off.

—
Camila Reyes
